notes: Probed 2026-09-05 via adb: Android 13, MediaTek Helio G95, BMI220 accel+gyro at 200 Hz, Mali-G76 GLES 3.2, 1080x2400 @ 60 Hz. Back camera hardware level 3 but normal capture sessions cap at 30 fps (high-speed 120 fps only at 720p in constrained mode). Expect camera exposure+readout ~33 ms, so the 45 ms motion-to-photon target is at risk on this phone; measure before qualification. roll_sign and theta_mount_deg must come from the jig sweep (tools/jig/analyse.py).
